mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage (story_id, direction, status, suggested_chapter_count, target_chapter_count, target_characters) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{direction}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PLANNING'), #{suggestedChapterCount}, #{targetChapterCount}, #{targetCharacters})
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, direction, status, suggested_chapter_count, target_chapter_count, target_characters, created_at, updated_at FROM stage WHERE id = #{id}
